name: Eagle County Regional Airport

runway.v: one runway, 9,000 ft (about 2,743 m) long and 150 ft (about 46 m) wide; field elevation 6,547 ft

handling.v: Signature Aviation is the FBO, on the south side of the airport

customs.v: CBP clears aircraft Thursday to Monday 09:00-17:00 Mountain Time; closed Tuesday and Wednesday; after-hours service only if asked during duty hours; aircraft are cleared plane-side on the Signature ramp; user fee airport (fee charged through the FBO); no commercial cargo; in bad weather divert to Denver International unless another CBP airport is arranged

permits.v: user fee airport for customs: a fee is charged; 3 hours' notice before arrival for all aircraft; customs office inside the Signature Aviation FBO; eAPIS (private) or APIS (charter) needed for all international flights
permits.quote: 3 hours advance notice is required prior to arrival for all aircraft.

notes: Only the airport's own site flyvail.com could be read (Statistics & Research and Signature Aviation pages, no dates shown); it states no curfew, customs or operating hours. The CBP fact sheet for Eagle County (KEGE GA Airport Fact Sheet, 1 Sep 2026, https://www.cbp.gov/sites/default/files/2026-09/KEGE%20GA%20Airport%20Fact%20Sheet%2020260901.pdf) exists but cbp.gov refused the fetch; eaglecounty.us/Airport and flyvail.com/general-aviation/ are robots-blocked. FAA Chart Supplement / d-TPP (aeronav.faa.gov), FAA NFDC airport data (nfdc.faa.gov, robots-blocked) and ADIP (adip.faa.gov) could not be opened. Metres are my conversion (1 ft = 0.3048 m). 1 Nov 2026: added customs from the CBP KEGE fact sheet of 25 Oct 2024 (KEGE-1024) and the airport's US Customs page (last modified 27 Dec 2023). A newer CBP sheet dated 1 Sep 2026 (https://www.cbp.gov/sites/default/files/2026-09/KEGE%20GA%20Airport%20Fact%20Sheet%2020260901.pdf) could not be opened (permission request not answered); check it, as its hours may differ. The CBP sheet states no days per season; the hours window covers Thursday-Monday only. No official source on curfew or airport hours was found.
